description: APPLICATION CALLED IN BY SECRETARY OF STATE - ITEM RELATES TO AN UPDATE ON THE APPEAL - Outline planning application (including means of access with all other matters reserved) for the demolition of existing buildings and the comprehensive phased redevelopment of the site for a mix of uses including up to 1049 residential units (Use Class C3), and up to 1200 sqm of flexible commercial and community floorspace (Use Classes A3/B1/D1 and D2) in buildings ranging from 3 to 18 storeys along with car and cycle parking  landscaping and associated works (this application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement)
decision: Called in by Secretary of State
